content: Implement cleanup services layer for user deletion with session and token revocation
activeForm: Implementing cleanup services layer for user deletion with session and token revocation
description: Create user-cleanup.service.ts with cleanupUserSessions method that handles post-deletion cleanup. Revokes all JWT tokens, clears Redis cache, removes from online users, and closes WebSocket connections. Write 3 MVP-tier tests (integration tests for token revocation, cache clearing, and error handling). This subtask will be used by the controller in T3.4.

checkpoints.name: Cleanup Service Implementation Complete
checkpoints.requirement: UserCleanupService created with cleanupUserSessions method and token/cache/WebSocket handlers

checkpoints.name: MVP Cleanup Tests Passing
checkpoints.requirement: All 3 tests passing (token revocation, cache clearing, graceful error handling verified)

phases.name: Cleanup Service Creation
actions: Implement: revokeTokens(userId: number) - revoke all JWT tokens for user
Implement: clearCache(userId: number) - clear Redis cache entries
Implement: removeFromOnlineUsers(userId: number) - remove from online tracking
Implement: closeWebSocketConnections(userId: number) - close active WS connections
phases.gate: Cleanup service must handle token revocation and cache clearing before proceeding

phases.name: Error Handling and Resilience
actions: Handle: Redis connection failure (log error, continue cleanup)
Handle: Partial cleanup failure (log, don't throw)

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (3 tests)
actions: Write: Test 1 - Revoke all user tokens successfully
Write: Test 2 - Clear user cache entries
Write: Test 3 - Graceful handling when Redis is down
Verify: All 3 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of cleanup service
